---
title: FIMS Calendar
---

FIMS has both recurring meetings, such as FIMS Code Club and FIMS Implementation Team meetings, and one-off meetings each month. See the calendar below for meeting descriptions and links to running notes. If a meeting is public, the description includes a Google Meet link.

Let us know on the [contact page](../contact/index.qmd) if there are meetings you are interested in joining, since not all meeting links are provided in the calendar. Implementation Team meetings are currently limited to [Implementation Team members](../contact/contributors.qmd#core-developers).

If the embedded calendar is difficult to use, open the [FIMS Community Calendar in a new tab](https://calendar.google.com/calendar/embed?src=c_6eluv1h8o830k7vt8ctcs6ghto%40group.calendar.google.com&ctz=America%2FNew_York).

Add the FIMS calendar to your own calendar by selecting `Add to calendar` at the bottom of the embedded calendar.
